description: A drifted key inside a closed object is what drop removes.

divergence.note: A batch whose changed paths are all undeclared reports `applied` and advances the active revision: the baseline reduces the strictest apply policy over the changed paths starting from `live`, and a path with no governing node contributes nothing, so a repair that only removes a drifted key pretends to be live. Its own docstring states that `live` is the policy a node without an explicit apply must not get. SPEC.md amendment 8 fixes undeclared as `restart`; the corrected answer is `restart_required` with the active revision left where the application actually is.
